`final class MsdfGlyph`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.impl.msdf` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [MsdfGlyph.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/impl/msdf/MsdfGlyph.java)

One glyph of an MSDF face, with its advance and where it sits on the line and in the atlas.

- [MSDF text](/use/in-depth/msdf-text/)

|---|---|---|
| [`MsdfGlyph`](/reference/text/msdfglyph/) | [of](#MsdfGlyph-factory-of)(int codepoint, float advance, MsdfBounds planeBounds, MsdfBounds atlasBounds) <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span> | Creates the glyph of `codepoint` with its `advance` on 1 of the em, its plane bounds and its atlas bounds; a glyph without bounds, such as a space, has `null` for both. |

## Methods

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `int` | [getCodepoint](#MsdfGlyph-method-getCodepoint)() | Returns the character of the glyph. |
| `float` | [getAdvance](#MsdfGlyph-method-getAdvance)() | Returns the distance to the next glyph, on 1 of the em. |
| [`MsdfBounds`](/reference/text/msdfbounds/) | [getPlaneBounds](#MsdfGlyph-method-getPlaneBounds)() | Returns the bounds of the glyph around its origin on the baseline, on 1 of the em with Y up, or `null` for a glyph that draws nothing. |

## Creation details

<a id="MsdfGlyph-factory-of"></a>

### of

`MsdfGlyph of(int codepoint, float advance, MsdfBounds planeBounds, MsdfBounds atlasBounds)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Creates the glyph of `codepoint` with its `advance` on 1 of the em, its plane bounds and its atlas bounds; a glyph without bounds, such as a space, has `null` for both.

## Method details

<a id="MsdfGlyph-method-getCodepoint"></a>

### getCodepoint

`int getCodepoint()` 

Returns the character of the glyph.

<a id="MsdfGlyph-method-getAdvance"></a>

### getAdvance

`float getAdvance()` 

Returns the distance to the next glyph, on 1 of the em.

<a id="MsdfGlyph-method-getPlaneBounds"></a>

### getPlaneBounds

`MsdfBounds getPlaneBounds()` 

Returns the bounds of the glyph around its origin on the baseline, on 1 of the em with Y up, or `null` for a glyph that draws nothing.

<a id="MsdfGlyph-method-getAtlasBounds"></a>

### getAtlasBounds

`MsdfBounds getAtlasBounds()` 

Returns the bounds of the glyph in the atlas image, in pixels, or `null` for a glyph that draws nothing.
